list: The official 55 trophies, as Exophase and PSNProfiles listed them before launch (names, descriptions and grades agree on both). Guides below are this guide's own words; locations and steps the public guides had not pinned down by 19 Nov 2026 are marked unverified, not guessed.

trophies.guide: The capstone: it pops the moment the other 54 trophies are yours, with nothing extra to do for it. Do not chase it first — work the Roadmap tab in order and the platinum arrives last, on its own. PowerPyx puts the whole run at about 200 hours at difficulty 4 out of 10.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.safe: It unlocks automatically once the other 54 are earned; nothing can lock it out.

trophies.guide: Story, unmissable. Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing — the first mission of Chapter 1. The trophy pops at the mission's end, so just play the story.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.safe: Story trophy — it pops when the opening mission ends and cannot be missed.

trophies.guide: Story, unmissable. Play Chapter 1 through to its end; the trophy pops when the chapter closes. Do the Chapter 1 meditation for Positive Mental Attitude before the chapter ends — see that trophy's guide.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.safe: Chapter trophy — it pops when Chapter 1 ends and cannot be missed.

trophies.guide: Story, unmissable. Complete Chapter 2 by playing its main missions in order. Chapter trophies follow the story, not side content, so no detour is needed for this one.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.safe: Chapter trophy — it pops when Chapter 2 ends and cannot be missed.

trophies.guide: Story, unmissable. Complete Chapter 3 by playing its main missions in order. Keep the partner trophies in mind while the story keeps Lucia and Jason together — see Hot Together and Retail Therapy.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.safe: Chapter trophy — it pops when Chapter 3 ends and cannot be missed.

trophies.guide: Story, unmissable. Complete Chapter 4 by playing its main missions in order. By this point the side-character strands (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) are open — their final missions each carry a trophy.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.safe: Chapter trophy — it pops when Chapter 4 ends and cannot be missed.

trophies.guide: Story, unmissable. Complete the final mission and the gold pops. There is no mission replay, so the story is played once — finish it and this is yours. After the credits, free roam stays open for everything left.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.safe: Story trophy — it pops when the final mission ends and cannot be missed.

trophies.guide: Story, unmissable. Complete the mission Breakfast Run when it appears in the story. Mission trophies pop at the end of the named mission — no extra objective is needed.
trophies.name: Trust
trophies.safe: Mission trophy — it pops when Breakfast Run ends and cannot be missed.

trophies.guide: Story, unmissable. Complete the mission The Cartel Heist when it appears in the story. Mission trophies pop at the end of the named mission.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.safe: Mission trophy — it pops when The Cartel Heist ends and cannot be missed.

trophies.guide: Story, unmissable. Complete the mission Child's Play when it appears in the story. Mission trophies pop at the end of the named mission.
trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.safe: Mission trophy — it pops when Child's Play ends and cannot be missed.

trophies.guide: Story, unmissable. Complete the mission Headliners when it appears in the story. Mission trophies pop at the end of the named mission.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.safe: Mission trophy — it pops when Headliners ends and cannot be missed.

trophies.guide: Story, unmissable. Complete the mission VCIA Takedown when it appears in the story. Mission trophies pop at the end of the named mission.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.safe: Mission trophy — it pops when VCIA Takedown ends and cannot be missed.

trophies.guide: Story, unmissable. Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory when it appears in the story. Mission trophies pop at the end of the named mission.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.safe: Mission trophy — it pops when Operation Savage Glory ends and cannot be missed.

trophies.guide: The long one. Reach 100% completion: after the story, open Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion — the checklist unlocks there — and work it down. PowerPyx rates this the hardest trophy and the whole platinum at about 200 hours, but notes the 100% thresholds are lenient, roughly 60% of true completion. Progress made during the story already counts, and nothing on the checklist is missable — everything can be done in free roam after the story.
trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.safe: Checklist trophy — nothing on the 100% checklist is missable; it can all be finished in free roam after the story.

trophies.guide: Grind, free roam. Land 250 stunts — jumps, near-misses and airtime, whatever the game counts as a stunt. The counter on this card tracks your running total; stunts stack across the whole playthrough, so start early and let them pile up while you do races and exploration. One of the longest grinds on the road to the platinum.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.safe: Count-based — stunts stack across the whole playthrough and can be finished in free roam.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sampler. Try each activity type the game offers once — fishing, races, the shooting range, drone races, the arcade, bowling, meditation, hunting and the rest; PSNProfiles puts the count at 9 types. Dip into each one as you meet it during the story and free roam, and tick it off on this card. Nothing here is missable.
trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.safe: Sampler — every activity type stays available in free roam after the story.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Skill grind. Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Take one range at a time: gold needs clean accuracy and speed, so learn each challenge's layout first and chase the medal after. The counter tracks how many you have golded.
trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.safe: Repeatable challenge — every range can be retried as often as needed.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Races. Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations. Learn each course's line first — you only need one win per location, not a win in every race the game offers.
trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.safe: Repeatable races — every location stays open in free roam.

trophies.guide: Races. Win 20 different races — different events, not the same one 20 times. Mix race types as you travel the map; the counter tracks distinct wins.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.safe: Count-based — distinct race wins stack across the whole game.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Duel. Beat Cal in a fishing challenge — take the fishing challenge against him when it appears through the fishing activity and out-fish him. If you lose, challenge him again; a lost challenge is not a lost trophy.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.safe: Repeatable challenge — a lost fishing challenge can be retried.

trophies.guide: Arcade. Complete one arcade game — play any arcade cabinet through to its end. Pick the game you enjoy most; the easiest one you like is the right one.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.safe: Repeatable — arcade cabinets stay playable in free roam.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Side story. Complete the final mission for Andy — follow Andy's mission strand to its last mission. Character strands open as the story progresses and their missions stay available, so work through them whenever they appear.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.safe: Side-story strand — its missions stay available and cannot be missed.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Side story. Complete the final mission for Kenton — follow Kenton's mission strand to its last mission. Character strands open as the story progresses and their missions stay available.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.safe: Side-story strand — its missions stay available and cannot be missed.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Side story. Complete the final mission for Billy — follow Billy's mission strand to its last mission. Character strands open as the story progresses and their missions stay available.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.safe: Side-story strand — its missions stay available and cannot be missed.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Side content. Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Stranger missions appear as icons around the map — finish any 8 strands end to end. There are far more than 8 strands available, and PowerPyx notes there are easily 200–300+ optional missions in total, so a few disappearing does not matter; the count is what counts.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.safe: Count-based with a large surplus — far more than 8 strands exist, so disappearing ones do not matter.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Side story. Complete the final mission for Randy — follow Randy's mission strand to its last mission. Character strands open as the story progresses and their missions stay available.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.safe: Side-story strand — its missions stay available and cannot be missed.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Side story. Complete the final mission for Tyrone — follow Tyrone's mission strand to its last mission. Character strands open as the story progresses and their missions stay available.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.safe: Side-story strand — its missions stay available and cannot be missed.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE ONE POSSIBLY MISSABLE TROPHY — do this early. Meditate at every spot across Leonida: 18 spots at 10 locations. The catch, flagged by both PowerPyx and GTABase: the first meditation is Lucia on the balcony at Jason's house in Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth — in the morning, talk to Lucia in the kitchen, follow her to the balcony and choose Accept. It is unconfirmed whether that session counts toward the trophy, and it may disappear after Chapter 1, so do it while you can. After that, meditate at every marked spot; meditating with both Lucia and Jason at one spot counts +2. The counter on this card tracks spots visited.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt. Hunt a unique animal for Bret — follow Bret's strand until the unique-animal hunt appears, then take the shot. One animal is enough; the hunt is the point, not a collection.
trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.safe: Strand mission — it stays available until you take the hunt.

trophies.guide: Collectibles. Complete 3 Collectible Card sets — find cards scattered around Leonida and finish any 3 sets. Cards are not story-gated, so sweep them during the free-roam cleanup stage instead of hunting them mid-story.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.safe: Collectibles — cards stay where they are and can be picked up in free roam.

trophies.guide: Collectibles. WAiNK It at 100 locations — find the WAiNK spots around Leonida and use the interaction at each. The counter tracks your running total. Fold this into exploration so you are not backtracking later: a spot found while travelling is a spot done.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.safe: Count-based — WAiNK spots stay in the world and can be visited in free roam.

trophies.guide: Challenges. Complete 50 Challenges — the game's challenge list (stunts, races, activities and more) feeds this count. Play broadly and the number climbs on its own; open the Challenges menu to see which ones are nearest and chase those.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.safe: Count-based — challenges stack across the whole game and stay open in free roam.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Partner moment. Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Build 4 stars while your partner is with you, then break line of sight and stay hidden until the stars clear. Partner moments are easiest while the story keeps Lucia and Jason together — take the chance when it appears instead of leaving it for post-game, when your partner may not be around.
trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.safe: Repeatable in free roam whenever your partner is with you; the story keeps pairing you up.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Partner moment. Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Plan a route past three shops, rob each quickly, and keep the wanted level alive between them — if it clears, the chain breaks and you start over. Best attempted while partner missions keep you paired.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.safe: Repeatable — shop robberies with your partner can be retried; a broken chain just restarts the count.

trophies.guide: Collection. Discover 100 vehicles — drive or enter new vehicle models and the game logs each new one. Variety beats repetition: only new models count. The counter tracks discoveries; fold this into travel and you will pass 100 without a dedicated grind.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.safe: Count-based — new vehicle models keep appearing across the whole game.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat. Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Find a group of five or more, trigger Combat Focus, and chain the takedowns before it ends. Pick a crowded fight, not a duel — and do not waste the Focus on the first enemy you see.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.safe: Repeatable combat feat — any crowded fight is another attempt.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Stunt. Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — the airport. The description points at the airport itself: get a plane airborne from VCIA outside a mission, i.e. take one and leave. How the game judges 'unscheduled' is not yet pinned down in public guides — try a plain theft-and-takeoff in free roam first, and expect a wanted level on the way out.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.safe: Free-roam stunt — the airport stays open after the story, so it can be retried.

trophies.guide: Combat — UNVERIFIED. The description is deliberately vague ('Kinda hot in these Rhinos') and the public guides have not yet pinned the exact trigger. Expect it to involve Rhino tanks in combat; try engaging Rhinos in free roam and watch for the pop. Do not chase a guessed method — check the linked guides again once the community pins it down.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.safe: Nothing in the description ties it to a one-time moment; it reads as a free-roam combat feat, and PowerPyx does not flag it missable.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Stealth. Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet — no alarms, no one spotting you — take the goods and get out clean. If you are spotted, leave and try again; a failed attempt does not lock the trophy.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.safe: Repeatable — a detected attempt can simply be retried.

trophies.guide: Heists. Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape — five separate vault robberies, each ending in a clean getaway. Plan each one and do not rush the escape; the counter tracks vaults cleared.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.safe: Count-based — vaults can be robbed across the whole game and stay open in free roam.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Heist. Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Find a truck on the road, stop it, take the cash and lose the heat. Trucks patrol the map, so this is a free-roam job, not a mission.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.safe: Free-roam job — armored trucks keep patrolling after the story.

trophies.guide: Exploration. Explore all 52 areas of Leonida — the counter tracks areas visited and the map fills in as you go. Fold this into every other task: drive everywhere and do not fast-travel past new ground.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.safe: Count-based — areas stay explorable in free roam after the story.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Heists. Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs — one per gang. Illegal operations show on the map; work through the gang list and the counter tracks which gangs you have hit.
trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.safe: Count-based — illegal operations stay on the map in free roam.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Moment — UNVERIFIED. Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The description is the whole clue: find a beachfront bar spot on Ocean Beach, order the cocktail and take in the view. PowerPyx lists the exact trigger as not yet known, so try the beachfront bars in free roam rather than following a guessed location.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.safe: Nothing in the description ties it to a one-time moment; Ocean Beach stays open in free roam, and PowerPyx does not flag it missable.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Moment — UNVERIFIED. Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style: take a car through a showroom's glass, the classic GTA exit. PowerPyx lists the exact showroom and trigger as not yet known — try the big showrooms in free roam and expect a wanted level.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.safe: Nothing in the description ties it to a one-time moment; showrooms stay open in free roam, and PowerPyx does not flag it missable.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Activity. Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley — play a game of bowling there to its end. One full game is enough; the alley stays open afterwards.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.safe: Repeatable activity — the bowling alley stays open in free roam.

trophies.guide: Moment — UNVERIFIED. The description ('A partnership with mass appeal') is deliberately vague and the public guides have not yet pinned the trigger — most likely a partner-activity moment. Do not chase guesses; check the linked guides once the community pins it down.
trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.safe: Nothing in the description ties it to a one-time moment, and PowerPyx does not flag it missable.

trophies.guide: Meta. Choices made, for better or worse. PSN tracks a count to 500 — the trophy follows the Criminal Profile choices you make across the game, so keep choosing and the counter tracks your running total. One warning from PowerPyx and GTABase: the Irredeemable profile is permanent, so read up on the Criminal Profile before going on a rampage.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.safe: Count-based — choices stack across the whole game; nothing about it is one-time.

trophies.guide: Moment — UNVERIFIED. 'Second time's the charm' hints at succeeding on a second attempt, but the exact trigger is not yet pinned down in public guides. Do not chase a guessed method — check the linked guides once the community pins it down.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.safe: Nothing in the description ties it to a one-time moment, and PowerPyx does not flag it missable.

trophies.guide: Moment — UNVERIFIED. 'What the hell just happened?' hints at a strange event — most likely a random encounter or easter egg somewhere in Leonida. The exact trigger is not yet pinned down in public guides; keep playing and it will find you, or check the linked guides once it is pinned down.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.safe: Nothing in the description ties it to a one-time moment, and PowerPyx does not flag it missable.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Combat driving — UNVERIFIED. Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by: knock someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle. The exact trigger is not yet pinned down in public guides — try a melee swing from a slow-moving vehicle in free roam. Marked unverified rather than guessed.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.safe: Nothing in the description ties it to a one-time moment, and PowerPyx does not flag it missable.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Money. Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists; launder them through your contacts over time. The counter tracks dollars laundered — it stacks across the whole game, so do not rush it; the robberies feed it naturally.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.safe: Count-based — laundering stacks across the whole game and contacts stay available.

trophies.guide: Money. Spend $100,000 across all shops. Buy cars, clothes, weapons and upgrades — all shop spending counts. It stacks across the game, so spend as you play and the counter tracks it; do not blow cash early just for this.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.safe: Count-based — shop spending stacks across the whole game.

trophies.guide: Properties. Purchase all 8 garage properties. Garages unlock as the story progresses; buy each one when it appears. The counter tracks garages owned — money for them comes from the same robberies that feed Dime on the Dollar.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.safe: Count-based — garages stay purchasable in free roam after the story.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: App. Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app — photograph or register vehicles you find through the app. The counter tracks registrations; new models you discover for Whip It Good are good candidates.
trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.safe: Count-based — vehicles can be registered any time in free roam.
